article.story: Western Kentucky (4-6) at No. 22 Liberty (9-1), Nov. 21 at 1 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Liberty by 16.5. Against the spread: Liberty 7-3, Western Kentucky 5-5. How to watch: ESPN+ Key stats Liberty Offense Overall: 412.1 yards per game (39th in FBS) Passing: 190.6 yards per game (105th) Rushing: 221.5 yards per game (11th) Scoring: 32.8 points per game (31st) Liberty Defense Overall: 284.7 yards per game (11th in FBS) Passing: 187.4 yards per game (32nd) Rushing: 97.3 yards per game (14th) Scoring: 14.5 points per game (8th) Western Kentucky Offense Overall: 377.6 yards per game (70th in FBS) Passing: 223.5 yards per game (70th) Rushing: 154.1 yards per game (69th) Scoring: 24.6 points per game (90th) Western Kentucky Defense Overall: 384.4 yards per game (92nd in FBS) Passing: 222.6 yards per game (88th) Rushing: 161.8 yards per game (92nd) Scoring: 32.4 points per game (126th) Western Kentucky is 74th in third down percentage, converting 39.3% of the time. Liberty ranks 15th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 31.5%. Western Kentucky is 112th in the FBS with a -5 turnover margin, compared to Liberty's 11th-ranked +8 margin. Liberty is 129th in the FBS averaging 74.9 penalty yards per game, compared to Western Kentucky's 11th-ranked 38.9 per-game average. Western Kentucky is 90th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 82.4% of trips. Liberty's red zone defense ranks 25th at 76.2%. Western Kentucky is 56th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 30:40, compared to Liberty's 3rd-ranked average of 34:03. Team leaders Liberty Passing: Deshawn Purdie, 1,769 yards, 12 TDs, 1 INT, 62.4 completion percentage Rushing: Kam Davis, 792 yards on 122 carries, 9 TDs Receiving: Makai Jackson, 752 yards on 40 catches, 7 TDs Western Kentucky Passing: Brock Glenn, 1,121 yards, 8 TDs, 4 INTs, 56.6 completion percentage Rushing: Glenn, 604 yards on 113 carries, 8 TDs Receiving: Jonathan Stafford Jr., 543 yards on 56 catches, 1 TD Last game Liberty defeated Middle Tennessee 28-23 on Nov. 14. Purdie passed for 64 yards on 8-of-17 attempts (47.1%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for 45 yards. Davis had 126 rushing yards on 20 carries and one touchdown. Jackson had five receptions for 50 yards and one touchdown. Western Kentucky beat Jacksonville State 34-24 on Nov. 14. Rodney Tisdale Jr. led Western Kentucky with 120 yards on 14-of-16 passing (87.5%) for no touchdowns and one interception. Glenn carried the ball 13 times for 71 yards and scored two touchdowns. Zion Taylor had six receptions for 52 yards. Next game Liberty plays at Missouri State on Nov. 28. Western Kentucky hosts Kennesaw State on Nov. 28.
